ranker: Original texts retain their native path scores. New pronunciation paths use their exact Viterbi CTC alignment for the path condition. The alignment condition sums CTC alignments. If a text has multiple proposed pronunciations, keep its highest acoustic score. Both add 1.25 times the same teacher-forced DistilGPT2 log likelihood.
reference_policy: Use the completed proposed texts and existing likelihoods. Resolve the tuning allowlist before reading any references. No new calibration or weight sweep.
precision: BF16 on an allocated CUDA GPU; FP32 token-logprob accumulation
scoring: Reuse frozen trial-level top-25 scores and score only texts missing from each trial cache. Preserve original acoustic scores and deterministic candidate order.
